messages:
maria: flagging a small but persistent mismatch between the token-cost dashboard and the cache-savings ledger after sticky-v2. looks like stitched responses are labeled as prefetch in the UI.

jon: example trace?

maria: trace 0x7b1a. model=atlas-7b-q4, router=sticky-v2, stitch_id=st-321, cache_hit=true, origin=null. dashboard shows ~95 tokens prefetch saved; billing export shows no prefetch credits.

ria: we've seen this: attributor defaults missing origin -> prefetch. stitch_id often lands after router rewrites, so origin gets lost.

ciara: short-term: attributor change to precedence: if stitch_id != null -> kv_stitch; else if origin != null -> origin; else -> inferred_prefetch. low-risk and reversible.

jon: agree. also add a metric telemetry.tag.stitch_origin_missing_ratio and alert if >1% in 1m.

maria: UX: add tooltip explaining "stitch = KV reuse, not billable prefetch" and an "attribution mode" toggle (current vs legacy) for audits.

ciara: add attribution_reason column to econ export (stitch,inferred-prefetch,explicit-prefetch,none). finance will thank us.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary queued: attributor-1.8.4-canary. monitor /deploys/attributor and /metrics/attributor.*

jon: will open PR with tests + metric + small backfill flag for data-team to re-run 24h aggregation after canary. aiming prod rollout tomorrow if green.
